title: Plumeform question types (v2)
description: A dark band: heading at the left and a long explanation with an underlined link at the right; under the heading, labelled groups of outlined pill chips with small icons and mint PLUS badges (one chip picked out with a mint rim); beside them a stack of frosted cards (two peeking out behind) with a round back button, a paper 'next' pill and a counter. Underneath, the whole catalogue as a quiet five-column list. Chips brighten on hover; everything rises and un-blurs into view.
notes: dark by itself (dark class); the card's body is a slot (a live example or a screenshot), a placeholder when empty
the back / next buttons are links you point at your own pages
phones show only the first chip group, as one row that scrolls sideways
